text:
Amy K: Quick sync — we need to lock the design partner (DP) seeding windows + feedback SLA for the private preview next month. Proposal: 3 waves (A: 20 early integrators, 1 week intensive; B: 50 expanded, 2 weeks; C: 30 continuous roll). Primary asks: recruitment sequencing, gating criteria for rollout, feedback capture cadence, incentives.

Ben P: Question — how hard do we want the release gates? e.g. quality regression thresholds, error spikes. Concrete numbers help.

Carla R: Draft metrics: completion rate >= 75% for onboarding flows, qualitative NPS >= 6/10, critical regressions <= 1 per model update, and latency p95 < 300ms for request/response path. If any of those fail in Wave A, pause and fix.

Sam (SRE): Ops notes: we can guarantee 99.5% infra availability for dedicated test pools. Need to reserve burst capacity for Wave A and B start days. Recommend staggering invites by 48h windows (small batches every 24-48h) to avoid onboarding spikes.

Amy K: Incentives idea: Wave A gets $200 credits + 1:1 onboarding + priority bug queue and a feature prioritization call. Wave B gets $75 credit + group onboarding. Wave C is opt-in ongoing with standard credits. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

Ben P: +1 to that tiering. Also recommend a dedicated async feedback channel + biweekly 30m sync for Wave A. Capture prompt sets + auto-evals from day 1.

Carla R: For feedback capture: use three buckets — 1) blocker/bug, 2) quality/regression & prompting, 3) UX/console ops. Each submission must include minimal repro (prompt, model version, expected vs observed). We'll run automated evals nightly against the prompt set.

Sam (SRE): Ops action items: please tag all DP traffic with the tag `dp-2026-q2` so routing/costs/retention are isolated. Example tag snippet for infra team:
```
resource_labels:
  program: "dp-2026-q2"
  cohort: "wave-a"
```
Also add SLO alerts to #product-oncall and #eng-oncall.

DevRelBot: Reminder — create Confluence intake page and publish the opt-in form to the candidate list. Template here: https://redwood.company/confluence/dp-intake-template (update with incentives & schedule).

Amy K: Who owns sequencing and copy for invites? @Ben P?

Ben P: I can own sequencing + invite copy. Will draft the message today and post for review.

Carla R: I'll own the eval harness + nightly auto-eval setup. Will coordinate with Sam on log access.

Sam (SRE): I'll reserve the test pools, set up tagging, and create the alert runbook. Need final numbers on expected rps per cohort to size burst.

Amy K: Great — TL;DR action list: 
- Ben: invite copy + sequencing by EOD
- Sam: reserve pools + tagging policy + alert runbook (Tues)
- Carla: eval harness + prompt set + dashboard (Mon)
- DevRelBot / Ops: Confluence intake & opt-in form (today)
We will triage launch gates next Wed 9am PST. If Wave A metrics fail (per Carla's thresholds), we pause rollout. :thumbsup:

Ben P: Noted. I'll include the gating checklist in the invite so partners know acceptance criteria.

Carla R: One more ask — add a short 3-question micro-survey after onboarding to capture initial signal (ease, usefulness, blockers). I'll add those to the Confluence template.

Amy K: Perfect. Thanks everyone — feel free to ping here with drafts.

(automated) DevRelBot: New DP intake created: https://redwood.company/confluence/dp-2026-q2-intake — please review and update.
